LIST1.TITLE: When Perpendicular Parking (Parking in a Garage)

ITEM.PTXT: The "estimated course lines" indicate the steering angle when reversing; by reversing while operating the steering wheel so that the estimated course lines match the lines of the parking space, the vehicle can be guided into the parking space.

The "vehicle width extension lines" serve as a guide when parking straight within a space; by judging the relationship (intersecting → parallel) between the parking space lines and the vehicle width extension lines, it can be confirmed that the vehicle is facing straight into the space.
